attributes.action: End the practice of airing the first one or two episodes of a new series on TV
attributes.additional_details: Not everyone can access streaming services, and the quality of viewing experience can be poor, so if someone chooses to use the service, that is their choice, but to tease terrestrial TV viewers with something they can't actually see in it's entirety on free to air, is not reasonable or fair. Anything that airs on free TV should be the complete article or you compromise the very concept of free TV, creating a 2 tier TV reality.
attributes.background: Free to air broadcasters who also have streaming services air 1 or 2 episodes of a new series on terrestrial TV, then make the rest of the series only available on their streaming service. This is unfair, and compromises the concept of free to air TV. Anything aired on free TV, should be complete.
